articles.summary: NEW YORK -- August 19, 2026 -- Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY) (Paris: COTY) ("Coty" or "the Company") today announced its results for the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026, ended June 30, 2026. Coty delivered Q4 and FY26 sales, profit, and cash flow ahead of expectations, supported by cost control and the convergence of sales and sell-out.
articles.title: COTY ANNOUNCES FOURTH QUARTER FISCAL YEAR 2026 RESULTS

articles.summary: NEW YORK, 19 August 2026 - Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY) (Paris: COTY) ("Coty" or "the Company") today announced the appointment of Soraya Benchikh as Chief Financial Officer (CFO), effective September 1, 2026. Benchikh succeeds Laurent Mercier.
articles.title: COTY APPOINTS SORAYA BENCHIKH CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER
